title: AlphaSense Raises $350M at $7.5B Valuation, Surpasses $600M ARR
summary: AlphaSense raised $350 million at a $7.5 billion valuation in a round led by Vitruvian Partners, with participation from Accenture Ventures and J.P. Morgan Asset Management. The company said it surpassed $600 million in annual recurring revenue in Q1 2026, up from $500 million in October 2025. AlphaSense, which acquired Tegus for $930M in 2024, continues to expand its expert transcript library and AI research tooling.
whyItMatters: AlphaSense's valuation nearly doubling from $4B (2024) to $7.5B alongside $600M+ ARR underscores that the research-platform model blending market intelligence, financial data, and expert transcripts is attracting the category's largest capital and growth.
